text:
Asking rents in Bonn stand at a median of 13.54 €/m² (2026-06), up 4.6% on the year and +24.3% over five years. That ranks Bonn #12 of 37 cities; new lets are priced 49% above the 2022 average contract rent of 9.09 €/m².

A 60 m² flat costs about 812 € a month in cold rent, 16.8% of the disposable income of two residents. Listings stay online for about 23 days and 34% are gone within a week; with 1.6% market-active vacancy and +3.0% population growth over five years, the market looks tight.

The model estimate for twelve months ahead is 14.30 €/m² (+5.6%), with an 80% range of 13.93 to 14.64 €/m²; housing-loan rates are at 4.01%.
